hints.title: Bulky Condition Evaluation
hints.text: A box is bulky if length >= 10^4 or width >= 10^4 or height >= 10^4 or volume >= 10^9.

hints.title: Heavy Condition Evaluation
hints.text: A box is heavy if mass >= 100.

hints.title: Category Mapping
hints.text: Return 'Both', 'Bulky', 'Heavy', or 'Neither' according to boolean combinations of both flags.

hints.title: Box Categorization Implementation

variables: length, width, height, mass: box dimensions
complexity.notes: Direct integer arithmetic and condition branching.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: No iterative or complex structure needed.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Handles 64-bit volume multiplication correctly without overflow.
